changelog: **Scored CV review with a gap checklist and role tailoring (#2050):** `cv_feedback` now returns a `CvReview` instead of prose — an overall 0–100 score, a band derived from it (`needs_work` < 50 ≤ `nearly` < 75 ≤ `ready`, never the model's own label), six fixed, ordered sections (contact & links, structure, impact statements, skills evidence, education, language quality) each with a score and findings, an actionable checklist (`ok` / `missing` / `weak` + how to fix) and a summary, requested as a JSON schema and parsed with `safeParseModelJson` (a reply that is not it is metered `parse_error`, stored nowhere, answered neutrally). `POST /api/cv/feedback` takes an optional `requisitionId` for a role the mentee is connected to (a non-PASS company interest or an interview request — anything else is `404 role_not_found`); the posting is sent fenced as untrusted data (#2026) and the tailoring block always names the required skills the CV text never mentions, computed deterministically (`missingRequiredSkills`) and merged with the model's. Reviews persist as `AiArtifact`s keyed on CV text + requisition (the column carries the requisition), so re-opening is free; `GET` returns the latest plus the previous score for the same target, and the card shows the delta. Prose artefacts stored before this change still render. The card (`CvReviewView`) shows score, band, delta, checklist, sections and tailoring through `AiText`, keeps the neutral copy on every denial, and now shows a stored review even when no provider is configured. Shared reviews render as reviews on the mentor's view. The score is advice: nothing reads it to gate a stage or rank a candidate, and no company screen shows it. `cv_feedback` output cap raised to 1 600 tokens for the structured reply.

en: CV feedback is now a score out of 100 with a checklist of what to fix, section by section — and it can be tailored to a role a company is considering you for. Re-review after an update and see how much you improved.
tr: CV geri bildirimi artık 100 üzerinden bir puan ve bölüm bölüm neyin düzeltileceğini gösteren bir kontrol listesi — ve bir şirketin seni düşündüğü bir role göre uyarlanabiliyor. Güncellemeden sonra yeniden incelet, ne kadar geliştiğini gör.
de: Das Lebenslauf-Feedback ist jetzt ein Score von 100 mit einer Checkliste, was Abschnitt für Abschnitt zu verbessern ist — und es lässt sich auf eine Stelle zuschneiden, für die ein Unternehmen dich in Betracht zieht. Nach einer Überarbeitung erneut prüfen und sehen, wie viel besser du geworden bist.
